items: Class में students गिनना = natural; empty desk count = 0 (whole); temperature +/− = integers
रोटी का आधा हिस्सा = fraction — अभी तक पढ़ा; negative depth के लिए rational चाहिए
Bank: ₹150 profit = +150; ₹100 loss = −100 (integers) — fractional loss/profit भी हो सकता है
Basement parking: ground से 1/2 floor नीचे → −1/2 floor (rational idea)
Cricket: 3 runs in 2 overs → rate 3/2 (ratio → rational form)
Shop: ₹23 for 10 items → 23/10 = 2.3 per item (decimal as rational)

examples.concept: अंश, हर और समतुल्य परिमेय संख्याएँ
items: Pizza: 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6 — same share, अलग cutting — equivalent idea
Money: ₹−5 = −5/1 rupee — integer as rational in accounts
Temperature: +2/5° rise vs −2/5° fall — positive vs negative rational change
Lift: 3/4 floor up (+) vs 3/4 floor down (−)
Village road: school 1/2 km east, home 1/2 km west of चौक — mirror distances
Thermometer scale: +1/2° and −1/2° equally away from 0
Recipe simplify: 45/30 cup = 3/2 cup — same quantity, simplest form
Class votes: −18/45 agreement ratio → −2/5 standard for report
Debt: −₹1/2 thousand vs −₹1/5 thousand — कम negative = better (बड़ा algebraically)
Temperature: −1/2° colder than −1/5° — smaller on number line
